title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋~Precast prestressed double-tee roofs
focus: 以斷面性質、預力反拱、缺口梁端、翼板連接器與吊裝連接完成度，確保雙 T 梁屋蓋從工廠到使用期間都可靠~Section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service
summary: 從雙 T 梁斷面與屋頂荷載路徑出發，計算預力反拱與長期撓度、缺口梁端吊筋與水平束制力、翼板連接器的隔板剪力，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定與連接完成、反拱差與屋面排水、放鬆時端部應力與出廠品質、現場載重試驗，最後談屋面防水與連接器腐蝕、改裝開孔與交接，並以美國職業安全衛生署對邁阿密戴德學院停車場與 Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁事故的調查報告對照。~Starting from the double-tee section and the roof load path, compute prestress camber and long-term deflection, dapped-end hangers and horizontal restraint forces, and diaphragm shear on flange connectors, then handle temporary stability and completed connections during erection, camber differential and roof drainage, end stresses at transfer and plant quality, and in-situ load testing, and finally roof waterproofing and connector corrosion, alterations and handover, compared with OSHA investigation reports on the Miami Dade College garage and Montgomery Mall double-tee incidents.

units.anchor: 雙 T 梁斷面~Double-tee section
units.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑~Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof
units.mechanism: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。屋頂荷載包括自重、防水與設備的附加靜載、活載或雪載與積水雨載，經翼板傳到腹肋，再經腹肋端部擱置在倒 T 梁、牆或牛腿上的承壓墊。翼板之間以焊接連接器相連，使整片屋頂成為傳遞風與地震力的隔板。這個系統輕、快、跨度大，但每一個端部與連接器都是關鍵。~A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side. Roof loads, namely self-weight, superimposed dead load from roofing and equipment, live or snow load and ponding rain, pass from the flange into the stems and then through bearing pads at the stem ends onto inverted-tee beams, walls or corbels. Flanges are joined by welded connectors so that the whole roof acts as a diaphragm carrying wind and earthquake forces. The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical.
units.model: 教學斷面：翼板 3,000×50 mm、兩腹肋平均寬 200 mm 高 750 mm，總高 800 mm，A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm²，自重 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa）。附加靜載 0.5 kPa、屋頂活載 1.0 kPa、跨度 24 m：w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。~The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type.
units.failure: 若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。~If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path.
units.misconception: 雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。~Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.
units.practice: 設計與機電要在初期就確定屋頂設備的位置與重量，並在雙 T 梁配置圖上標示允許集中荷載區；後續新增設備必須由結構技師檢核。~Structural and services teams should fix rooftop equipment locations and weights early and mark allowable concentrated-load zones on the double-tee layout; any later equipment must be checked by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 預力鋼絞線與反拱~Strands and camber
units.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度~Prestress camber and long-term deflection
units.mechanism: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。之後混凝土潛變使反拱隨時間增長，但預力損失與附加靜載又會抵銷一部分。對屋頂而言，反拱關係到排水坡度、防水層、與相鄰構件的高差，以及屋面設備與天窗的安裝。PCI 設計手冊提供以乘數估算安裝時與長期撓度的簡化方法。~Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. Creep then increases camber with time, partly offset by prestress losses and superimposed dead load. For a roof, camber affects drainage slope, waterproofing, level differences with adjacent members, and the fit of equipment and skylights. The PCI Design Handbook offers a simplified multiplier method to estimate deflections at erection and in the long term.
units.model: I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。反拱 P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm，自重撓度 ≈ 51.7 mm，放鬆淨反拱約 14 mm；以長期乘數 2.45、2.70 與附加靜載 3.0 計，最終淨反拱只剩約 2 mm。數值為教學假設。~With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN. Camber P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm and self-weight deflection ≈ 51.7 mm, a net release camber of about 14 mm; with long-term multipliers of 2.45, 2.70 and 3.0 for superimposed dead load, the final net camber is only about 2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。~The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance.
units.failure: 若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。~If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights.
units.misconception: 預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。~A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant.
units.practice: 屋面排水坡度應由支承高程或構件傾斜提供，不應只靠反拱；圖說中標示預估安裝時反拱與允許差值，並要求相鄰雙 T 梁的堆置時間盡量一致。~Roof drainage slope should come from bearing elevations or sloping members rather than camber alone; drawings should show predicted erection camber and allowable differences, and adjacent tees should have similar storage ages where possible.

units.anchor: 端部缺口與承壓墊~Dapped end and bearing pad
units.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力~Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint
units.mechanism: 為了讓屋頂高程平順，雙 T 梁腹肋端部常做成缺口（dapped end），擱置在倒 T 梁或牆的承壓墊上。缺口的內角是應力集中處，剪力必須靠吊筋把力從下方的缺口段傳到上方全斷面，並配置水平鋼筋抵抗端部水平力。承壓墊讓構件因乾縮、潛變與溫度變化而自由伸縮；若端部被焊死或承壓墊被灌漿填滿，這些體積變化會被束制，產生水平拉力，使缺口內角開裂。~To keep roof levels smooth, stem ends are often dapped and seated on bearing pads on inverted-tee beams or walls. The re-entrant corner of a dap concentrates stress, so hanger reinforcement must lift shear from the reduced nib into the full section above, with horizontal bars resisting end tension. Bearing pads let the member move freely with shrinkage, creep and temperature change; if ends are welded rigidly or pads are grouted solid, these volume changes are restrained and create horizontal tension that cracks the dap corner.
units.model: 每根腹肋端部反力 V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN，取水平束制力 N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN。缺口吊筋 A_sh = V_u/(φ·f_y) = 117,400/(0.75×420) ≈ 373 mm²，可用 2 支 D16（2×199 = 398 mm²），並另配水平筋抵抗 N_u。數值為教學假設。~Each stem end carries V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN, with a horizontal restraint force taken as N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN. Dap hanger steel A_sh = V_u/(φ·f_y) = 117,400/(0.75×420) ≈ 373 mm², met by 2 D16 bars (2×199 = 398 mm²), with separate horizontal bars for N_u. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置；安裝時量測實際擱置長度與承壓墊位置，確認墊片未偏出或被擠壓變形。~Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting; at erection measure actual seating length and pad position, confirming pads are not displaced or squeezed out.
units.failure: 缺口內角在多年溫度循環下出現斜裂縫並逐漸擴大，若吊筋不足或錨定不夠，缺口段可能突然剪斷，整片雙 T 梁一端掉落；承壓墊老化或移位使腹肋直接壓在混凝土邊緣，邊緣剝落後擱置長度不足。~Diagonal cracks at the dap corner grow over years of thermal cycling, and with too little hanger steel or anchorage the nib can shear off suddenly, dropping one end of the tee; aged or displaced pads let the stem bear directly on the concrete edge, which spalls until seating becomes inadequate.
units.misconception: 雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。~Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
units.practice: 端部連接應區分哪一端允許滑動、焊接件設計成可容納體積變化，並在圖說中禁止以灌漿填滿承壓墊周圍；缺口內角的裂縫寬度列入定期檢查項目。~End connections should distinguish which end may slide, with welded hardware designed to accommodate volume change, and drawings should forbid grouting solid around bearing pads; crack width at dap corners belongs in periodic inspections.

units.anchor: 翼板焊接連接器~Flange weld connectors
units.title: 翼板連接器與屋頂隔板~Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm
units.mechanism: 沒有現澆面層的雙 T 梁屋頂，隔板作用完全依賴相鄰翼板之間的焊接連接器與周邊弦材：連接器傳遞翼板接縫上的剪力，同時讓相鄰構件的撓度協調，避免集中荷載只由一片雙 T 梁承受。弦材與集力構件把隔板力送到抗側力牆或構架。連接器間距、預埋鋼件的錨定與現場焊接品質，決定了屋頂能否在風與地震中作為一個整體。~In an untopped double-tee roof, diaphragm action relies entirely on welded connectors between adjacent flanges and on perimeter chords: connectors transfer shear along flange joints and make adjacent members deflect together, so a concentrated load is not carried by one tee alone. Chords and collectors deliver diaphragm force to lateral walls or frames. Connector spacing, anchorage of embedded hardware and field weld quality decide whether the roof works as one unit in wind and earthquakes.
units.model: 屋頂 48 m × 24 m、重量 (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN，隔板設計力 0.2W ≈ 945 kN。隔板以兩端牆為支承，端部剪力 V = 945/2 ≈ 472 kN，沿 24 m 接縫的剪力流 q ≈ 472/24 ≈ 19.7 kN/m；連接器間距 1.5 m 時每個需約 29.5 kN。數值為教學假設。~A 48 m × 24 m roof weighs (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN, and the diaphragm design force is 0.2W ≈ 945 kN. Spanning between end walls, the diaphragm end shear is V = 945/2 ≈ 472 kN, a shear flow along the 24 m joint of q ≈ 472/24 ≈ 19.7 kN/m, so connectors at 1.5 m spacing each need about 29.5 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。~Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant; field welds are made by qualified welders to an approved procedure, every weld is visually checked for size and logged, and a sample is tested non-destructively.
units.failure: 連接器漏焊或焊道過小時，地震或強風下翼板接縫被撕開，屋頂分裂成獨立的條狀構件，牆頂失去側向支撐而外傾；連接器間距過大，則屋頂集中荷載使相鄰翼板高差增加，防水層被拉裂。~Missed or undersized connector welds let flange joints tear open in an earthquake or strong wind, splitting the roof into independent strips and leaving wall tops unbraced to lean outward; widely spaced connectors let concentrated loads open level differences between flanges, tearing the waterproofing.
units.misconception: 雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。~Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
units.practice: 連接器配置圖要標示每一個連接器的位置與編號，焊接完成以噴漆或標籤標記並由檢驗人員簽認；未完成連接器的區域不得堆放材料或作為設備通道。~The connector layout should number every connector, and completed welds are marked with paint or tags and signed by the inspector; no materials may be stockpiled and no equipment may travel over areas with incomplete connectors.

units.anchor: 吊點與端部焊接完成~Lifting points and completed end welds
units.title: 吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成~Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections
units.mechanism: 雙 T 梁吊裝快速，但在端部與翼板連接完成前，每一片都只是擱置在承壓墊上的獨立構件，支承它的柱、倒 T 梁與牆也可能尚未灌漿或焊接完成。美國職業安全衛生署的調查顯示：2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場倒塌，起因是一根柱底未灌漿而由墊片承壓，柱荷載約 1,360 kips 超過估計承壓能力 839 至 1,050 kips；2016 年重建工地則有兩片雙 T 梁在相鄰構件調整墊片時倒塌，當天放置的 7 片中有 4 片只有一處或沒有完成規定的 4 處端部焊接。~Double tees go up quickly, but until end and flange connections are complete each unit is just a member resting on pads, and the columns, inverted tees and walls supporting it may themselves be ungrouted or unwelded. OSHA investigations show that the 2012 Miami Dade College garage collapse began at a column whose base was never grouted and bore on shims, with a column load of about 1,360 kips exceeding an estimated bearing capacity of 839 to 1,050 kips; at the rebuilt garage in 2016, two tees fell while shims were adjusted on an adjacent member, and four of the seven placed that day had one or none of the four required end welds.
units.model: 雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN；吊索與水平夾角 60° 時吊索拉力 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN，乘動力係數 1.2 約 89.8 kN；若吊點要求 4 倍安全係數，極限能力須 ≥ 約 359 kN。數值為教學假設，不是吊掛作業許可。~A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each; at a 60° sling angle the sling tension is 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN, about 89.8 kN with a 1.2 dynamic factor, so with a required safety factor of 4 the insert needs an ultimate capacity of at least about 359 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not a rigging permit.
units.verify: 吊裝計畫列出每片雙 T 梁的重量、吊點與吊具、放置順序、每一階段需完成的端部與翼板焊接、支承柱與倒 T 梁的灌漿狀態，以及臨時支撐；每片放置後由檢驗人員確認焊接數量與位置，才允許放鬆吊鉤或在其上方繼續作業。~The erection plan lists weight, lifting points and rigging, placing order, the end and flange welds required at each stage, the grouting status of supporting columns and inverted tees, and temporary bracing; after each tee is placed an inspector confirms the number and location of welds before the hook is released or work continues above.
units.failure: 為了趕進度而在支承柱尚未灌漿、端部焊接未完成時連續放置大量構件，一個支承失效就引起連鎖倒塌；以吊車而非千斤頂調整墊片，吊鉤勾住吊點把構件拉起，也是 2016 年事故的直接原因之一。~Placing many members in quick succession while supporting columns are ungrouted and end welds incomplete means one failed support can trigger progressive collapse; using the crane instead of jacks to adjust shims, so that a hook caught a lifting insert and pulled the member up, was one direct cause of the 2016 incident.
units.misconception: 雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。~Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
units.practice: 合約與吊裝計畫應把柱底灌漿、端部焊接與翼板焊接列為停止點，規定未完成前不得在上方放置構件，並由結構技師或其指定人員簽認；吊車不得用來調整已放置構件的高程。這些是檢核要求，不是作業許可。~The contract and erection plan should make column-base grouting, end welds and flange welds hold points, prohibiting members above until they are complete, signed off by the structural engineer or a delegate; cranes must not be used to adjust the level of placed members. These are inspection requirements, not operating permits.

units.anchor: 相鄰反拱差與排水坡~Adjacent camber difference and drainage slope
units.title: 反拱差調整與屋面排水~Camber differential and roof drainage
units.mechanism: 相鄰雙 T 梁因混凝土強度、放鬆時間與堆置天數不同，反拱可能相差十幾公釐，翼板接縫出現高低差。焊接連接器前必須先把高差拉平，通常以夾具、千斤頂或加載方式調整，強行焊接則會在連接器與翼板中留下應力。另一方面，雙 T 梁屋頂的長期淨反拱往往很小，屋面排水坡度若不足，暴雨時積水增加荷載，形成積水—撓度—更多積水的循環，因此屋頂的雨水荷載與排水設計和結構設計密不可分。~Adjacent double tees can differ in camber by more than ten millimetres because of different concrete strength, release time and storage age, leaving steps at flange joints. These must be pulled level before connectors are welded, usually with clamps, jacks or surcharge, since forced welding locks stresses into connectors and flanges. Moreover, long-term net camber of a double-tee roof is often small, so with too little drainage slope a downpour ponds water, adding load in a ponding–deflection–more-ponding cycle; rain load and drainage design are therefore inseparable from the structural design of the roof.
units.model: 以 ASCE 7 型式的雨水荷載 R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa（d 以 mm 計）。主排水堵塞時到溢流口的靜水深 d_s = 50 mm、溢流水頭 d_h = 25 mm：R = 0.0098×75 ≈ 0.74 kPa，接近屋頂活載 1.0 kPa。前一單元的最終淨反拱只約 2 mm，坡度必須由支承高程提供。數值為教學假設。~Using the ASCE 7 form of rain load, R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa with depths in mm. With a static head of d_s = 50 mm to the overflow when primary drains are blocked and a hydraulic head of d_h = 25 mm, R = 0.0098×75 ≈ 0.74 kPa, close to the 1.0 kPa roof live load. The final net camber from the previous unit is only about 2 mm, so slope must come from bearing elevations. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝後量測每條翼板接縫兩側高程差，超過允許值者記錄調整方式與調整後高程；屋面完成後做排水測試或在雨後檢查積水範圍，確認主排水與溢流口高程符合設計。~After erection, measure the level difference across every flange joint, recording adjustment method and final levels where tolerance is exceeded; after roofing, run a drainage test or inspect ponding after rain to confirm that primary drain and overflow levels match the design.
units.failure: 以強力夾具或吊車壓平高差後立即焊接，連接器在溫度循環中疲勞斷裂；屋頂溢流口高於設計或被雜物堵住，暴雨時積水深度超過假設，雙 T 梁撓度增加又積更多水，嚴重時導致局部屋頂崩塌。~Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling; overflows set higher than designed or blocked by debris let ponding exceed the assumed depth in a downpour, so the tees deflect, collect more water and in severe cases part of the roof collapses.
units.misconception: 屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。~As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally.
units.practice: 屋頂排水設計須同時提供主排水與獨立溢流，並把溢流高程與雨水荷載假設寫入結構計算書；相鄰構件高差的允許值與調整方法要在安裝規範中明訂，調整作業以千斤頂等可控方式進行並設停止點。~Roof drainage must provide both primary drains and independent overflows, with overflow levels and rain-load assumptions written into the structural calculations; the installation specification should set allowable steps between adjacent members and adjustment methods, using controlled means such as jacks with a hold point.

units.anchor: 放鬆時端部應力~Transfer stress at ends
units.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質~Transfer checks and plant quality control
units.mechanism: 預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。若頂部拉應力超過容許值，翼板會開裂，因此常把部分鋼絞線在端部脫黏、把鋼絞線折線配置，或在頂部配置黏結鋼筋。工廠品質管理還包括放鬆強度試體、尺寸與預埋件位置、反拱量測與端部裂縫檢查，PCI 設有工廠認證制度。~Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest. If top tension exceeds its limit the flange cracks, so some strands are debonded at the ends, strands are harped, or bonded top reinforcement is added. Plant quality control also covers release-strength cylinders, dimensions and embed positions, camber measurement and end-crack inspection, and PCI runs a plant certification programme.
units.model: 梁端（無自重彎矩）：σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa，小於 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa（f'ci = 30 MPa）；σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa 拉應力，大於 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，須脫黏、折線或配頂部鋼筋。數值為教學假設。~At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。~Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark.
units.failure: 若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線；脫黏長度錯誤或鋼絞線放鬆順序不對稱，則雙 T 梁側彎或扭曲，安裝時兩腹肋無法同時落在承壓墊上。~Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands; wrong debonded lengths or an asymmetric release sequence bow or twist the tee so both stems cannot seat on their pads at erection.
units.misconception: 預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。~A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks.
units.practice: 優先採用通過 PCI 工廠認證或同等品質制度的預鑄廠，出廠文件要附放鬆強度、反拱、尺寸與裂縫檢查紀錄；設計者應在圖說中明訂放鬆強度與允許的端部裂縫寬度。~Prefer plants certified by PCI or an equivalent quality scheme, with shipping documents that include release strength, camber, dimension and crack-inspection records; designers should specify release strength and allowable end-crack width on drawings.

units.anchor: 現場載重試驗~In-situ load test
units.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗~Field deflection survey and load testing
units.mechanism: 當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。預力構件在未開裂時撓度接近線性且回復良好，若加載過程撓度突然增加或回復不足，代表已開裂或預力鋼絞線受損。試驗本身有風險，必須事先設計荷載級距、停止條件與安全支撐。~When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured. Uncracked prestressed members deflect almost linearly and recover well; a sudden jump in deflection or poor recovery signals cracking or strand damage. Testing itself carries risk, so load increments, stop criteria and safety shoring must be designed beforehand.
units.model: 以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。若試驗荷載下最大撓度 30 mm，小於 36 mm，可直接判定撓度合格；若超過，則需檢查卸載後的回復比例。數值為教學假設。~Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm. A maximum deflection of 30 mm under test load is below 36 mm and passes directly; if exceeded, recovery after unloading must be checked. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。~The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening.
units.failure: 若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。~Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading; measuring midspan deflection while ignoring support settlement mistakes bearing deformation for member deflection and leads to the wrong conclusion.
units.misconception: 預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。~A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
units.practice: 載重試驗須在結構技師監督下進行，試驗區域設禁入範圍並於構件下方架設不接觸的安全支撐；試驗是工程驗證的停止點，結果未經核可前不得恢復使用或增加荷載。~Load tests must run under the structural engineer's supervision, with an exclusion zone and non-contact safety shoring beneath the member; the test is an engineering hold point, and the roof may not return to use or take added load until results are approved.

units.anchor: 屋面接縫防水~Roof joint waterproofing
units.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕~Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion
units.mechanism: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。連接器多為外露鋼板，在潮濕與乾濕循環下腐蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降；承壓區長期潮濕則使缺口端部鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落。屋面維護因此不只是防漏，而是保護結構連接。~An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas. Connectors are usually exposed steel plates that corrode under wetting and drying, losing section and diaphragm capacity; persistently damp bearing areas rust dap reinforcement and spall concrete. Roof maintenance is therefore not only about leaks but about protecting structural connections.
units.model: 10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。數值為教學假設。~A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。~Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust; clean sample connectors to measure remaining thickness, and check bearing areas by eye and sounding for spalls, comparing with previous records.
units.failure: 長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。~Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake; spalling at bearings reduces seating length until, in extreme cases, one end of a tee slips off.
units.misconception: 屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。~Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees.
units.practice: 維護手冊要把屋面防水、接縫密封與連接器腐蝕列為同一檢查項目，訂定檢查週期與修復時限；更換防水層時須同步檢查並修補下方連接器，修補方式由結構技師核可。~The maintenance manual should treat membrane, joint sealants and connector corrosion as one inspection item with set intervals and repair deadlines; reroofing must include inspection and repair of connectors below, with repair methods approved by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 屋頂開孔與增設設備~Roof openings and added equipment
units.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接~Alterations, openings, removal and handover
units.mechanism: 雙 T 梁屋頂在使用期間常因增設空調、太陽能板或天窗而開孔或加載。翼板可在腹肋之間有限度開孔，但腹肋內的預力鋼絞線絕對不可切斷，切斷一股就直接減少強度並可能使端部錨定失效。移除或搬移既有雙 T 梁同樣危險：職業安全衛生署調查的 2013 年 Montgomery Mall 事故，是以千斤頂與滑移方式移除一片長約 60 ft、重約 42,800 lb 的雙 T 梁時，臨時支撐塔頂部鋼梁受壓挫屈，造成一死一傷。~Double-tee roofs are often cut or loaded in service for new air-conditioning, solar panels or skylights. The flange may take limited openings between stems, but strands inside the stems must never be cut, since cutting even one strand directly reduces strength and may undermine end anchorage. Removing or relocating existing tees is equally hazardous: in the 2013 Montgomery Mall incident investigated by OSHA, a tee about 60 ft long weighing about 42,800 lb was being removed by jacking and skating when the top beam of a temporary safety tower buckled, killing one worker and injuring another.
units.model: 12 股鋼絞線時 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比 M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80；若開孔切斷 2 股剩 10 股，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力由約 2.5 MPa 增為約 5.2 MPa，超過 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa，構件會開裂。數值為教學假設。~With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80; cutting 2 strands for an opening leaves 10 and φM_n of about 1,471 kN·m, raising the ratio to about 0.96, while service bottom tension rises from about 2.5 MPa to about 5.2 MPa, beyond 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa, so the member cracks. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。~Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points.
units.failure: 承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。~A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall.
units.misconception: 雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。~Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含雙 T 梁配置與編號圖、鋼絞線位置、允許開孔區、允許附加荷載、連接器與承壓檢查紀錄，並在屋頂入口與腹肋上標示「預力構件，禁止切割鑽孔」；移除或搬移構件須經結構技師設計臨時支撐並核可。~Handover should include the tee layout and marks, strand locations, permitted opening zones, allowable added loads and connector and bearing inspection records, with ‘prestressed member: do not cut or drill’ labels at roof access and on stems; removing or relocating members requires temporary supports designed and approved by the structural engineer.

example: 設計練習：教學雙 T 梁寬 3.0 m、高 800 mm、跨度 24 m，A = 450,000 mm²、I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm。自重 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa），加附加靜載 0.5 kPa 與屋頂活載 1.0 kPa，w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m。配置 12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、偏心 e ≈ 408 mm，以 f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa、f'c = 35 MPa 估計 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比約 0.80。放鬆時 P_i ≈ 2,016 kN：反拱約 65.7 mm、自重撓度約 51.7 mm，淨反拱約 14 mm；梁端頂部拉應力約 3.5 MPa，超過 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，需脫黏或折線配置。長期淨反拱只剩約 2 mm，排水坡度須由支承高程提供，並以雨水荷載約 0.74 kPa 檢核。每根腹肋端部反力約 117 kN，缺口吊筋約需 373 mm²。若日後切斷 2 股鋼絞線，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力約 5.2 MPa 會開裂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。~Design exercise: a teaching double tee 3.0 m wide and 800 mm deep spans 24 m, with A = 450,000 mm², I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴ and y_b ≈ 508 mm. Self-weight is 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa); with 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load and 1.0 kPa roof live load, w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Twelve 15.2 mm strands at e ≈ 408 mm, with f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa and f'c = 35 MPa, give φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and a demand ratio of about 0.80. At release P_i ≈ 2,016 kN: camber about 65.7 mm against self-weight deflection about 51.7 mm, a net of about 14 mm; top tension at the ends is about 3.5 MPa, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so strands must be debonded or harped. Long-term net camber is only about 2 mm, so drainage slope must come from bearing elevations, checked for a rain load of about 0.74 kPa. Each stem end reacts about 117 kN, needing about 373 mm² of dap hanger steel. If 2 strands are later cut, φM_n falls to about 1,471 kN·m, the demand ratio rises to about 0.96 and service bottom tension of about 5.2 MPa cracks the member. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.
history: 預力混凝土在 1950 年代的美國迅速發展，預鑄預力混凝土協會（PCI）於 1954 年成立，雙 T 梁因寬幅、輕量與大跨度成為停車場樓板與工業、商業建築屋頂的標準構件。隨著應用擴大，施工期間的事故也提供了重要教訓：美國職業安全衛生署調查 1990 年匹茲堡國際機場航廈預鑄屋頂構件吊裝時的倒塌、2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場倒塌、2013 年 Montgomery Mall 以千斤頂移除雙 T 梁時的倒塌，以及 2016 年邁阿密戴德學院重建停車場的雙 T 梁倒塌，共同指出支承灌漿、連接完成與臨時支撐的重要性。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Prestressed concrete expanded rapidly in the United States in the 1950s, the Precast/Prestressed Concrete Institute (PCI) was founded in 1954, and the double tee, wide, light and long-spanning, became a standard element for parking-structure floors and industrial and commercial roofs. As use grew, construction incidents provided key lessons: OSHA investigated the 1990 collapse of precast roof members during erection at the Greater Pittsburgh International Airport airside building, the 2012 Miami Dade College garage collapse, the 2013 Montgomery Mall collapse while a double tee was being removed by jacking, and the 2016 double-tee collapse at the rebuilt Miami Dade College garage, which together highlight support grouting, completed connections and temporary supports. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Montgomery Mall 事故中的雙 T 梁長約 60 ft（約 18.3 m）、寬 9 ft、深 2 ft 3 in，重約 42,800 lb（約 19.4 t）~The Montgomery Mall double tee was about 60 ft (about 18.3 m) long, 9 ft wide and 2 ft 3 in deep, weighing about 42,800 lb (about 19.4 t)
Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁翼板最小厚 4 in，兩腹肋間距 4 ft 6 in~The Montgomery Mall double tee had a 4 in minimum flange and stems 4 ft 6 in apart
2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場為 6 層、305 ft × 390 ft，倒塌範圍約 122 ft × 132 ft，4 人罹難~The 2012 Miami Dade College garage was 6 storeys and 305 ft × 390 ft; the collapse covered about 122 ft × 132 ft and killed 4 workers
該次倒塌的混凝土約 3,300 tons，其中雙 T 梁約 3,000 tons~About 3,300 tons of concrete fell in that collapse, including about 3,000 tons of double tees
職業安全衛生署估計未灌漿柱底承受約 1,360 kips，超過 839 至 1,050 kips 的估計承壓能力~OSHA estimated about 1,360 kips on the ungrouted column base, above an estimated bearing capacity of 839 to 1,050 kips
該停車場雙 T 梁深 30 in、寬 12 ft、翼板 4 in，契約要求柱底在吊裝後 48 小時內灌漿~That garage used double tees 30 in deep and 12 ft wide with 4 in flanges, and the contract required column-base grout within 48 hours of erection
2016 年重建停車場當天放置 7 片雙 T 梁，其中 4 片只有 1 處或沒有完成規定的 4 處端部焊接~At the rebuilt garage in 2016, 7 double tees were placed that day and 4 had 1 or none of the 4 required end welds
PCI 設計手冊目前為第 9 版~The PCI Design Handbook is currently in its 9th edition
